episodes.title: Nonsense & Sensibility
episodes.summary: Reeling from a breakup, New Yorker Jessica seizes the chance to move to London — which isn't quite the fairy tale she was hoping for.

episodes.title: Pity Woman
episodes.summary: Jessica gets swept off her feet and out of the hospital. As she shares the story with her new colleagues, she starts to question her own instincts.

episodes.title: Ignore Sunrise
episodes.summary: After a reprimand at work, Jessica resolves to have an early night. But as her relationship with Felix deepens, sleep is the last thing on their minds.

episodes.title: Notting Kill
episodes.summary: Jessica goes looking for warning signs in her romance. Until the couple go for dinner at her boss's house, and her own red flags start to wave.

episodes.title: Pink Valentine
episodes.summary: All of Jessica's old insecurities rise to the surface when she meets Felix's friends and revisits the collapse of her relationship back in New York.

episodes.title: To Doubt a Boy
episodes.summary: After an argument with his flatmate, Felix decides it's time to move out. Jessica goes on an awkward work trip with a formidably difficult director.

episodes.title: Terms of Resentment
episodes.summary: Felix goes to visit his family in the suburbs, not telling Jessica about their change in circumstances or the difficult childhood that still haunts him.

episodes.title: One Wedding and a Sex Pest
episodes.summary: The pair attends the wedding of one of Felix's oldest friends. It's the England Jessica was hoping to find — but not the one she wanted.

episodes.title: Enough, Actually
episodes.summary: With tension hanging in the air, both Felix and Jessica slide back into bad habits, and she makes a fatal error just before leaving for the shoot.

episodes.title: The Idea of Glue
episodes.summary: Felix takes charge when Astrid suffers a dire medical emergency. Jessica finally meets with someone she's been hoping to speak to for a very long time.
